skill.name: aws-solution-architect
skill.description: Design AWS architectures for startups using serverless services, infrastructure as code, cost optimization, and security best practices.
skill.summary: Generate AWS architecture guidance, serverless stack templates, cost reviews, and security recommendations for startup cloud projects.
skill.author: alirezarezvani

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, generated IaC syntax, AWS resource URLs, and architecture guidance. No evidence of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, shell execution, or malicious reconnaissance was found. One medium-risk semantic issue remains: generated API Gateway CORS settings are too broad for production use.

remediation.issue: Generated API Gateway CORS allows all origins and methods.
remediation.suggestion: Require callers to provide allowed origins and methods, and generate least-privilege CORS defaults for production templates.

remediation.issue: Generated infrastructure templates may be deployed directly by inexperienced users.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear review step before deployment for IAM scope, CORS policy, data retention, and environment-specific settings.

semantic_findings.title: Generated API Allows Broad CORS Access
semantic_findings.description: The generated CDK API Gateway configuration allows all origins and all methods. If deployed without narrowing these settings, browser clients from any origin could invoke allowed API methods and increase exposure.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The CDK template explicitly uses all origins and all methods for CORS. This is a common development default that can be risky in production, although Cognito authorization reduces impact.

content.value_statement: Early teams need AWS designs that balance speed, security, scale, and cost. This skill turns product requirements into practical AWS architecture guidance and infrastructure templates.
actual_capabilities: Recommend AWS service patterns for serverless, event-driven, three-tier, real-time, GraphQL, and multi-region systems.
Generate infrastructure-as-code templates for CloudFormation, AWS CDK, and Terraform serverless stacks.
Estimate monthly AWS costs for common startup architecture stages and traffic profiles.
Identify cost optimization opportunities such as log retention, VPC endpoints, unused Elastic IPs, and Savings Plans.
Provide security hardening guidance for IAM, encryption, API protection, audit logging, and secrets management.
Create deployment guidance, migration strategies, runbooks, and architecture decision support.
limitations: Generated templates need human review before deployment to production accounts.
Cost estimates are approximate and depend on region, traffic, storage, and pricing changes.
The skill provides architecture guidance but does not inspect live AWS accounts directly.
Some recommendations assume AWS-native services and may increase cloud provider lock-in.

use_cases.title: Plan an MVP backend
use_cases.description: Choose a low-cost serverless AWS stack for a new product with authentication, API, storage, and monitoring.

use_cases.title: Prepare for growth
use_cases.description: Evolve an existing architecture for more users, higher reliability, better observability, and controlled monthly spend.

use_cases.title: Generate deployment templates
use_cases.description: Create CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform starting points for serverless applications using Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and Cognito.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner architecture request
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a first AWS design for a simple product.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a simple AWS architecture for a new web application with user login, a REST API, and low monthly cost. Explain each service choice.

prompt_templates.title: Cost-aware serverless design
prompt_templates.scenario: You have traffic and budget constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a serverless AWS backend for 50,000 monthly active users with a monthly budget under $500. Include cost drivers and tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Infrastructure template generation
prompt_templates.scenario: You want a deployable starting point.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an AWS CDK architecture plan for a Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and Cognito backend. Include security settings to review before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced scale and compliance review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this AWS architecture for 100,000 users, GDPR requirements, and multi-region resilience. Recommend changes for security, reliability, cost, and operations.

output_examples.input: Design an MVP backend for a mobile app with authentication and simple data storage.
output_examples.output: A serverless design using Cognito, API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, and S3. The response explains why each service fits an MVP and gives an estimated monthly cost range.

output_examples.input: Help reduce AWS costs for a growing SaaS platform.
output: Review NAT Gateway usage and consider VPC endpoints.
Use Savings Plans for predictable compute.
Tag resources for cost allocation and ownership.

output_examples.input: Create a production readiness checklist for a generated serverless stack.
output_examples.output: A checklist covering IAM least privilege, CORS restrictions, encryption, CloudTrail, alarms, backup policy, deployment rollback, and environment separation.

best_practices: Provide traffic, budget, compliance, and team experience details before asking for an architecture.
Review generated infrastructure templates with cloud and security owners before deployment.
Ask for cost, reliability, and security tradeoffs when comparing AWS service choices.
anti_patterns: Do not deploy generated templates without checking IAM, CORS, retention, and environment settings.
Do not ask for a large-scale architecture without current usage, latency, and budget constraints.
Do not treat cost estimates as final quotes without checking current AWS regional pricing.

faq.question: Can this skill deploy resources to my AWS account?
faq.answer: No. It generates guidance and template text. You must review and deploy any infrastructure yourself.

faq.question: Does it support infrastructure as code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate starting templates for CloudFormation, AWS CDK, and Terraform patterns.

faq.question: Is it only for serverless systems?
faq.answer: No. It emphasizes serverless for startups but also covers three-tier, event-driven, analytics, GraphQL, and multi-region patterns.

faq.question: How accurate are the cost estimates?
faq.answer: They are planning estimates. Validate them with current AWS pricing and your expected region, traffic, storage, and support needs.

faq.question: Can it review security requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides guidance for IAM, encryption, secrets, API protection, audit logging, and compliance considerations.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Startup founders, cloud architects, platform engineers, and DevOps teams planning or reviewing AWS infrastructure.
